    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Base32Codec
    A byte-to-text-safe-byte transform using Base32: eight ASCII symbols per five bytes, over any alphabet of 32 symbols.
    Base64Codec
    A byte-to-text-safe-byte transform: encodes any bytes as Base64 (RFC 4648) and decodes them back.
    BoundedDataKeyStrategy
    Opt-in DataKeyStrategy that caches a data-encryption key (DEK) and rolls to a fresh one after maxMessages messages or maxAge has elapsed, whichever comes first.
    ChecksumCodec
    A Codec<byte[]> transform that appends a 32-bit checksum (big-endian) on encode and verifies it on decode, rejecting a mismatch with InvalidPayloadException.
    Codec<T>
    Converts values of type T to and from byte[].
    CodecDeserializer<T>
    Adapts a Codec to Kafka's Deserializer.
    CodecException
    The root of every failure a Codec reports from Codec.encode(T) or Codec.decode(byte[]).
    CodecFactory
    Produces Codec instances for arbitrary types, backed by a serialization library.
    CodecRedisCacheAutoConfiguration
    Serializes Redis cache values through the application's CodecFactory.
    CodecRedisCacheProperties
    Settings for serializing Redis cache values through the application's CodecFactory.
    CodecRedisSerializer<T>
    Adapts a Codec to Spring Data Redis's RedisSerializer, so a codec — with whatever compression or encryption it composes — is what Redis stores: 
    RedisTemplate<String, Person> template = new RedisTemplate<>();
template.setValueSerializer(CodecRedisSerializer.of(factory, Person.class));
    CodecSerde<T>
    A Kafka Serde pairing a CodecSerializer and CodecDeserializer over one codec, for Kafka Streams: 
    KStream<String, Person> people =
    builder.stream("people", Consumed.with(Serdes.String(), new CodecSerde<>(codec)));
    CodecSerializer<T>
    Adapts a Codec to Kafka's Serializer.
    CompressionStreamCodec
    Base class for stream-based compression transforms, intended for use with Codec.andThen(Codec).
    DataKey
    A data-encryption key (DEK) acquired from a DataKeyProvider: the plaintext key material used to encrypt or decrypt one message, paired with the id of the key-encryption key (KEK) that wrapped it and the wrapped (ciphertext) form of the key itself.
    DataKeyProvider
    SPI for envelope-encryption key management, implemented by consumers against an in-process key store or a remote KMS (AWS KMS, HashiCorp Vault, GCP Cloud KMS, etc.).
    DataKeyStrategy
    Pure lifecycle policy for acquiring the data-encryption key used to encode a message.
    DecryptionException
    Exception indicating that the data provided for decryption is invalid or corrupted.
    DeflateCodec
    Compresses with the zlib format (RFC 1950): DEFLATE data wrapped in a two-byte header and Adler-32 checksum.
    DirectDataKeyStrategy
    Default DataKeyStrategy: acquires a fresh data-encryption key per message.
    EncryptionException
    Exception indicating a failure during the encryption operation.
    EnvelopeCodec
    Envelope-encryption Codec for byte[]: encrypts with AES-256-GCM under a per-message data-encryption key (DEK), itself wrapped by a DataKeyProvider and carried alongside the ciphertext.
    EnvelopeCodec.Builder
    Builder for EnvelopeCodec.
    ForyCodecAutoConfiguration
    Registers a ForyCodecFactory when the application defines a ThreadSafeFory bean.
    ForyCodecFactory
    A CodecFactory backed by Apache Fory: fast binary serialization for JVM-to-JVM payloads such as cache entries, queue messages and journal records.
    GsonCodecAutoConfiguration
    Auto-configures a GsonCodecFactory when the Gson backend is on the classpath and no other CodecFactory bean exists.
    GsonCodecFactory
    Produces JSON codecs backed by a shared Gson instance.
    GzipCodec
    Compresses with the gzip format (RFC 1952): DEFLATE data wrapped in a gzip header and CRC-32 trailer.
    HexCodec
    A byte-to-text-safe-byte transform using hexadecimal (RFC 4648 base16): two ASCII digits per input byte.
    InvalidPayloadException
    The payload handed to Codec.decode(byte[]) is malformed, corrupt, or forged: bad framing, truncation, an authentication-tag or checksum mismatch, text outside an encoding's alphabet, a corrupt compressed stream, a payload that would expand past a size cap, or one that decodes to a type this codec does not produce.
    InvalidValueException
    The value handed to Codec.encode(T) cannot be encoded: a type the backend has no serializer for, a cyclic object graph, a class the backend requires to be registered and is not.
    Jackson2CodecAutoConfiguration
    Auto-configures a Jackson2CodecFactory when the Jackson 2.x backend is on the classpath and no other CodecFactory bean exists.
    Jackson2CodecFactory
    Produces JSON codecs backed by a shared Jackson 2.x ObjectMapper.
    JacksonCodecAutoConfiguration
    Auto-configures a JacksonCodecFactory when the Jackson 3.x backend is on the classpath and no other CodecFactory bean exists.
    JacksonCodecFactory
    Produces JSON codecs backed by a shared Jackson 3.x ObjectMapper.
    JceDataKeyProvider
    In-process DataKeyProvider for consumers without a KMS, backed by one or more key-encryption keys (KEKs) supplied at construction.
    JceDataKeyProvider.Builder
    Builder for JceDataKeyProvider.
    JsonbCodecAutoConfiguration
    Registers a JsonbCodecFactory when the JSON-B backend and API are on the classpath and no other backend has claimed the CodecFactory slot.
    JsonbCodecFactory
    A CodecFactory backed by Jakarta JSON Binding (JSON-B).
    KeyAccessException
    Exception indicating that key infrastructure is unavailable.
    Lz4Codec
    LZ4 compression as a Codec<byte[]> transform, for use with Codec.andThen.
    ProtobufCodecAutoConfiguration
    Auto-configures a ProtobufCodecFactory when the Protocol Buffers backend is on the classpath and no other CodecFactory bean exists.
    ProtobufCodecFactory
    Produces codecs for Protocol Buffers messages (GeneratedMessage subclasses), using each message type's own Parser.
    StringCodec
    A Codec<String> whose bytes are simply the text in a charset — no quoting, no framing.
    TransientCodecException
    Something the codec depends on failed, and the input is not at fault: a key-management service timed out or throttled, a JCE provider cannot supply a transform, a compressor failed on valid input, or a provider returned something that violates its contract.
    TypeRef<T>
    Super type token capturing a full generic type at compile time, surviving erasure.
    UnknownVersionException
    Signals that a payload carries valid versioned framing but names a version this codec has no codec registered for.
    UnsupportedFormatException
    The payload handed to Codec.decode(byte[]) is well-formed, but names a format this reader cannot handle: a version or an algorithm identifier this instance was not built to understand — typically because a newer writer produced it.
    VersionedCodec
    Prefixes every payload with a small self-describing header naming the codec that produced it, and dispatches on that header when decoding — so an application can change its storage strategy without rewriting what it has already stored.
    VersionedCodec.Builder<T>
    Collects the per-version codecs and the version to write, and validates them.
    VersionedFormatException
    Signals that a buffer handed to a versioned codec is not a well-formed versioned payload: it is shorter than the three-byte header, or it does not carry the versioned magic.
    ZstdCodec
    Zstandard (RFC 8878) compression as a Codec<byte[]> transform, for use with Codec.andThen.
